steps.say: Close view: the cut faces retain fine diagonal section lines. The blue box and teal sphere use live cut caps. The engine block has built-in section faces.
The model is now larger in world units but fits the same stage. Subpixel section lines should average into a steady tone instead of false dark bands.
At a grazing view the same filtering follows the projected spacing. This is a one-dimensional pixel-footprint approximation, not a new lighting or geometry effect.
Return to the original scale and view. The section pattern should return without changing the shapes, caps, or material colours.
